That was yesterday. This is now. You have: Wedding ring, Coat button, Dead Phone, Field suture kit, Dispatcher's headset. That's everything you own in this world. Haven. Twelve people. The fire is lit. They found a deer this morning. Inside out. Not eaten — unmade. Like something was trying to understand how it work
